walk.met: • Met: "revenue … about 1.5x to 1.7x of that" (May-25 call): FY26 revenue came in at 1.5x. Equity raise "over next couple of quarters" (May-24 call): ₹406 Cr preferential issue within two quarters. EBITDA margin of 65 to 75% by March (Jul-25 call): reached one quarter later.
walk.late: • Late: second south site "during the next quarter" (Jan-25 call): live 1 Aug-25.
walk.missed: • Missed: "double up … all the way to 4,096 before March" (Nov-25 call): the first 1,024 Blackwell went live in mid-May. Also, Nov-23 guidance to fund capex "without raising additional equity" was followed by the ₹406 Cr raise.
walk.unchecked: • Not checkable: MRR targets (₹35 to 40 Cr by March 2026). MRR is not reported. The quarterly average works out to about ₹32 Cr a month in Q4 FY26 and ₹52 Cr in Q1 FY27, which is suggestive, not proof.
walk.pattern: Pattern: revenue and margin targets hold; capacity and timing slip.

beyond: Ownership: promoter holding fell from 59.7% (Jun-24) to 39.5% (Jun-26). The big step was new shares, a ₹1,079 Cr preferential allotment to L&T in Dec-24, not promoter selling.
Governance: four independent directors resigned in 24 months (Dec-24, Mar-25, Aug-25, Jan-26). The company disputes a May-26 stamp-duty order. ICRA A- Stable. Trust gate: Amber, watch.
Moat: a proprietary in-house cloud software platform built since 2014 and 100+ engineers building compute, network and orchestration. This is the company's own claim.
undisclosed: Customer concentration: management gave the share of one customer (13 to 15% of Q2 revenue). Top-customer and top-10 shares were not given.
Contracted versus short-term mix: no target.
FY28 to FY29: "we never make any forward-looking predictions."
